from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
r=Path('docs/records/gpt6-agent-guidance-20261116'); e=r/'evidence'
prior=json.loads((e/'final.json').read_text())
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
files=['AGENTS.md','docs/agent/REVIEWER.md','docs/agent/REVIEWS.md','docs/PATTERNS.md','docs/agent/VERIFICATION.md']
# Prove that the template and previously reviewed guidance changed only as authorized.
t=Path('docs/agent/REVIEWER.md').read_text().replace('[AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)','[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)').replace('[review policy](REVIEWS.md)','[review policy](../docs/agent/REVIEWS.md)')
assert sha(t.encode())==prior['sourceBindings']['prompts/REVIEWER.md']['afterSha256']
a=Path('AGENTS.md').read_text().replace('docs/agent/REVIEWER.md','prompts/REVIEWER.md')
assert sha(a.encode())==prior['sourceBindings']['AGENTS.md']['afterSha256']
assert sha(Path('docs/agent/VERIFICATION.md').read_bytes())==prior['sourceBindings']['docs/agent/VERIFICATION.md']['afterSha256']
for name in ['docs/PATTERNS.md','docs/agent/REVIEWS.md']:
 old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+name],text=True)
 expected=old.replace('prompts/REVIEWER.md','docs/agent/REVIEWER.md') if name.endswith('PATTERNS.md') else old.replace('[prompts/REVIEWER.md](../../prompts/REVIEWER.md)','[docs/agent/REVIEWER.md](REVIEWER.md)')
 assert Path(name).read_text()==expected,name
assert not Path('prompts').exists()
# Reuse the previously exercised link resolver definitions without executing its checks.
source=Path('target/agent-guidance-validation/check.py').read_text()
namespace=dict(re=re,html=__import__('html'),unquote=__import__('urllib.parse',fromlist=['unquote']).unquote,urlsplit=__import__('urllib.parse',fromlist=['urlsplit']).urlsplit)
exec(source[source.index('def without_fences'):source.index('# Validator controls')],namespace)
# Preserve every prior evidence byte and the original report prefix.
index=json.loads((e/'final-source.json').read_text())
for name,info in index['files'].items():
 if name in files or name=='prompts/REVIEWER.md':continue
 data=Path(name).read_bytes()
 if name==str(r/'REPORT.md'):data=data[:info['bytes']]
 elif name in files or name=='prompts/REVIEWER.md':continue
 assert sha(data)==info['sha256'],name
appendix=(r/'REPORT.md').read_text().split('## Follow-up: review template relocation',1)[1]
for link in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',appendix):
 assert namespace['resolve_link']((r/'REPORT.md').resolve(),link) is None,link
checked=0
for name in files+['docs/agent/REPORTS.md','docs/BEST-PRACTICES.md','docs/MISTAKES.md','docs/TASK-LIFECYCLE.md','tasks/README.md']:
 text=namespace['without_fences'](Path(name).read_text())
 assert 'prompts/REVIEWER.md' not in text,name
 for link in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
  assert namespace['resolve_link'](Path(name).resolve(),link) is None,(name,link)
  if not __import__('urllib.parse',fromlist=['urlsplit']).urlsplit(link).scheme:checked+=1
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],check=True)
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()
assert set(changed)=={'AGENTS.md','docs/PATTERNS.md','docs/agent/REVIEWS.md','docs/agent/VERIFICATION.md','prompts/REVIEWER.md'}
untracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines()
assert all(n=='docs/agent/REVIEWER.md' or n.startswith(str(r)+'/') for n in untracked)
result={'command':['python3','target/agent-guidance-validation/relocation.py',sys.argv[1]],'validatorSource':Path(__file__).read_text(),'exitCode':0,'localLinksChecked':checked,'sourceBindings':{n:sha(Path(n).read_bytes()) for n in files},'templateChange':'path and two relative Markdown links only; reverse-normalized SHA matches previously reviewed template','policies':'all other previously reviewed guidance preserved; REVIEWS/PATTERNS path replacements only','historicalEvidence':'previous records unchanged except an append-only relocation section in REPORT.md; historical old-path links intentionally retained','trackedChanges':changed,'untracked':untracked}
(e/(sys.argv[1]+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['validatorSource','untracked']},indent=2))

policies: all other previously reviewed guidance preserved; REVIEWS/PATTERNS path replacements only
